name: putnam_1964_b2
proof:
theorem putnam_1964_b2
(S : Type*) [Fintype S] [Nonempty S]
(P : Finset (Set S))
(hPP : ∀ T ∈ P, ∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅)
(hPS : ¬∃ T : Set S, T ∉ P ∧ (∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅))
: (P.card = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1)) := by 
  have h_no_empty : ∀ (T : Set S), T ∈ P → T.Nonempty := by
    intro T hT
    have h₁ : T ∩ T ≠ ∅ := hPP T hT T hT
    have h₂ : T ∩ T = T := by simp only [inter_self]
    rw [h₂] at h₁
    exact Set.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr h₁
  
  have h_subset_or_compl : ∀ (A : Set S), A ∈ P ∨ Aᶜ ∈ P := by
    intro A
    by_contra! h
    have h₁ : A ∉ P := h.1
    have h₂ : Aᶜ ∉ P := h.2
    
    have h₃ : ∃ (U : Set S), U ∈ P ∧ A ∩ U = ∅ := by
      have h₄ : ¬(A ∉ P ∧ ∀ (U : Set S), U ∈ P → A ∩ U ≠ ∅) := by
        intro h₅
        have h₆ : ∃ (T : Set S), T ∉ P ∧ (∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅) := by
          refine' ⟨A, _⟩
          constructor
          · exact h₅.1
          · intro U hU
            have h₇ := h₅.2 U hU
            have h₈ : A ∩ U ≠ ∅ := h₇
            have h₉ : A ∩ U = U ∩ A := by
              ext x
              simp only [mem_inter_iff]
              <;> tauto
            have h₁₀ : U ∩ A ≠ ∅ := by
              intro h₁₁
              apply h₈
              simp_all only [ne_eq, Set.ext_iff, mem_inter_iff, mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false, not_and, not_forall,
    Classical.not_imp, not_not, not_exists, not_false_eq_true, and_self, not_true_eq_false]
              
            simpa [Set.inter_comm] using h₁₀
        exact hPS h₆
      by_cases h₅ : A ∉ P
      · have h₆ : ¬(∀ (U : Set S), U ∈ P → A ∩ U ≠ ∅) := by
          intro h₇
          exact h₄ ⟨h₅, h₇⟩
        push_neg at h₆
        obtain ⟨U, hU, h₈⟩ := h₆
        refine' ⟨U, hU, _⟩
        have h₉ : A ∩ U = ∅ := by
          by_contra h₁₀
          have h₁₁ : A ∩ U ≠ ∅ := h₁₀
          simp_all only [ne_eq, Set.ext_iff, mem_inter_iff, mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false, not_and, not_forall,
    Classical.not_imp, not_not, not_exists, not_false_eq_true, and_self, true_and]
          
        exact h₉
      · exfalso
        simp_all only [ne_eq, not_exists, not_and, not_forall, Classical.not_imp, not_not, not_false_eq_true,
    and_self]
    
    have h₄ : ∃ (V : Set S), V ∈ P ∧ Aᶜ ∩ V = ∅ := by
      have h₅ : ¬(Aᶜ ∉ P ∧ ∀ (U : Set S), U ∈ P → Aᶜ ∩ U ≠ ∅) := by
        intro h₆
        have h₇ : ∃ (T : Set S), T ∉ P ∧ (∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅) := by
          refine' ⟨Aᶜ, _⟩
          constructor
          · exact h₆.1
          · intro U hU
            have h₈ := h₆.2 U hU
            have h₉ : Aᶜ ∩ U ≠ ∅ := h₈
            have h₁₀ : Aᶜ ∩ U = U ∩ Aᶜ := by
              ext x
              simp only [mem_inter_iff, mem_compl_iff]
              <;> tauto
            have h₁₁ : U ∩ Aᶜ ≠ ∅ := by
              intro h₁₂
              apply h₉
              simp_all only [ne_eq, Set.ext_iff, mem_inter_iff, mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false, not_and, not_forall,
    Classical.not_imp, not_not, not_exists, not_false_eq_true, and_self, mem_compl_iff, not_true_eq_false]
              
            simpa [Set.inter_comm] using h₁₁
        exact hPS h₇
      by_cases h₆ : Aᶜ ∉ P
      · have h₇ : ¬(∀ (U : Set S), U ∈ P → Aᶜ ∩ U ≠ ∅) := by
          intro h₈
          exact h₅ ⟨h₆, h₈⟩
        push_neg at h₇
        obtain ⟨V, hV, h₈⟩ := h₇
        refine' ⟨V, hV, _⟩
        have h₉ : Aᶜ ∩ V = ∅ := by
          by_contra h₁₀
          have h₁₁ : Aᶜ ∩ V ≠ ∅ := h₁₀
          simp_all only [ne_eq, Set.ext_iff, mem_inter_iff, mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false, not_and, not_forall,
    Classical.not_imp, not_not, not_exists, not_false_eq_true, and_self, mem_compl_iff, true_and]
          
        exact h₉
      · exfalso
        simp_all only [ne_eq, not_exists, not_and, not_forall, Classical.not_imp, not_not, not_false_eq_true,
    and_self]
    
    obtain ⟨U, hU, hU'⟩ := h₃
    obtain ⟨V, hV, hV'⟩ := h₄
    
    have h₅ : U ⊆ Aᶜ := by
      intro x hx
      by_contra h₆
      have h₇ : x ∈ A := by simp_all only [ne_eq, not_exists, not_and, not_forall, Classical.not_imp, not_not, not_false_eq_true,
    and_self, mem_compl_iff]
      have h₈ : x ∈ A ∩ U := Set.mem_inter h₇ hx
      rw [hU'] at h₈
      simp only [mem_empty_iff_false] at h₈
      
    have h₆ : V ⊆ A := by
      intro x hx
      by_contra h₇
      have h₈ : x ∈ Aᶜ := by simp_all only [ne_eq, not_exists, not_and, not_forall, Classical.not_imp, not_not, not_false_eq_true,
    and_self, mem_compl_iff]
      have h₉ : x ∈ Aᶜ ∩ V := Set.mem_inter h₈ hx
      rw [hV'] at h₉
      simp only [mem_empty_iff_false] at h₉
      
    
    have h₇ : U ∩ V = ∅ := by
      apply Set.eq_empty_of_forall_not_mem
      intro x hx
      have h₈ : x ∈ U := Set.mem_of_mem_inter_left hx
      have h₉ : x ∈ V := Set.mem_of_mem_inter_right hx
      have h₁₀ : x ∈ Aᶜ := h₅ h₈
      have h₁₁ : x ∈ A := h₆ h₉
      simp_all only [ne_eq, not_exists, not_and, not_forall, Classical.not_imp, not_not, not_false_eq_true,
    and_self, mem_inter_iff, mem_compl_iff, not_true_eq_false]
      
    
    have h₈ : U ∩ V ≠ ∅ := hPP U hU V hV
    simp_all only [ne_eq, Set.ext_iff, mem_inter_iff, mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false, not_and, not_forall,
    Classical.not_imp, not_not, not_exists, not_false_eq_true, and_self, mem_compl_iff]
    
  
  have h_not_both : ∀ (A : Set S), A ∈ P → Aᶜ ∉ P := by
    intro A hA
    by_contra h
    have h₁ : Aᶜ ∈ P := h
    have h₂ : A ∩ Aᶜ = ∅ := by
      ext x
      simp only [inter_compl_self, mem_empty_iff_false]
      
    have h₃ : A ∩ Aᶜ ≠ ∅ := hPP A hA Aᶜ h₁
    rw [h₂] at h₃
    contradiction
  
  have h_card : P.card = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1) := by
    classical
    
    let Q : Finset (Set S) := (Finset.univ : Finset (Set S)) \ P
    
    have h₁ : P.card = Q.card := by
      
      have h₂ : ∀ (A : Set S), A ∈ P → Aᶜ ∈ Q := by
        intro A hA
        have h₃ : Aᶜ ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Set S)) := Finset.mem_univ _
        have h₄ : Aᶜ ∉ P := h_not_both A hA
        simp only [Finset.mem_sdiff, Q] at *
        tauto
      have h₃ : ∀ (A : Set S), A ∈ Q → Aᶜ ∈ P := by
        intro A hA
        have h₄ : A ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Set S)) := by
          simp only [Finset.mem_sdiff, Q] at hA
          tauto
        have h₅ : A ∉ P := by
          simp only [Finset.mem_sdiff, Q] at hA
          tauto
        have h₆ : A ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Set S)) := by tauto
        have h₇ : A ∈ P ∨ Aᶜ ∈ P := h_subset_or_compl A
        cases h₇ with
        | inl h₈ =>
          exfalso
          tauto
        | inr h₈ =>
          exact h₈
      
      have h₄ : P.card = Q.card := by
        
        have h₅ : P.card = Q.card := by
          
          have h₆ : ∀ (A : Set S), A ∈ P → Aᶜ ∈ Q := h₂
          have h₇ : ∀ (A : Set S), A ∈ Q → Aᶜ ∈ P := h₃
          
          have h₈ : P.card = Q.card := by
            
            apply Finset.card_bij' (fun A _ => Aᶜ) (fun A _ => Aᶜ)
            <;> simp_all [Set.ext_iff]
            
            
            
            
          exact h₈
        exact h₅
      exact h₄
    
    have h₂ : P.card + Q.card = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := by
      have h₃ : P.card + Q.card = (Finset.univ : Finset (Set S)).card := by
        have h₄ : Disjoint P Q := by
          rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
          intro A hA hA'
          simp only [Finset.mem_sdiff, Q] at hA'
          tauto
        have h₅ : P ∪ Q = (Finset.univ : Finset (Set S)) := by
          apply Finset.ext
          intro A
          simp only [Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_sdiff, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Q]
          <;>
          by_cases h₆ : A ∈ P <;> simp_all [h_subset_or_compl]
          
          
        have h₆ : P.card + Q.card = (P ∪ Q).card := by
          rw [← Finset.card_union_add_card_inter P Q]
          have h₇ : P ∩ Q = ∅ := Finset.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty.mp h₄
          rw [h₇]
          simp only [Finset.card_empty, add_zero]
        rw [h₅] at h₆
        exact h₆
      have h₄ : (Finset.univ : Finset (Set S)).card = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := by
        simp only [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_set]
        
        
        
        
        
      linarith
    
    have h₃ : P.card * 2 = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := by
      have h₄ : P.card + Q.card = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := h₂
      have h₅ : P.card = Q.card := h₁
      linarith
    
    have h₄ : Fintype.card S ≥ 1 := by
      have h₅ : Nonempty S := inferInstance
      have h₆ : 0 < Fintype.card S := by
        apply Fintype.card_pos_iff.mpr
        exact ⟨Classical.choice h₅⟩
      omega
    have h₅ : P.card = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1) := by
      have h₆ : P.card * 2 = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := h₃
      have h₇ : Fintype.card S ≥ 1 := h₄
      have h₈ : 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1) * 2 = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := by
        have h₉ : Fintype.card S - 1 + 1 = Fintype.card S := by
          have h₁₀ : Fintype.card S ≥ 1 := h₄
          omega
        calc
          2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1) * 2 = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1) * 2 ^ 1 := by norm_num
          _ = 2 ^ ((Fintype.card S - 1) + 1) := by
            rw [← pow_add]
          _ = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := by
            rw [h₉]
            
      have h₉ : P.card = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1) := by
        have h₁₀ : P.card * 2 = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := h₃
        have h₁₁ : 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1) * 2 = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := h₈
        have h₁₂ : P.card = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1) := by
          nlinarith
        exact h₁₂
      exact h₉
    exact h₅
  
  exact h_card

name: putnam_1964_b2
proof:
theorem putnam_1964_b2
(S : Type*) [Fintype S] [Nonempty S]
(P : Finset (Set S))
(hPP : ∀ T ∈ P, ∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅)
(hPS : ¬∃ T : Set S, T ∉ P ∧ (∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅))
: (P.card = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1)) := by 
  have h_no_empty : ∀ (T : Set S), T ∈ P → T.Nonempty := by
    intro T hT
    have h₁ : T ∩ T ≠ ∅ := hPP T hT T hT
    have h₂ : T ∩ T = T := by simp only [inter_self]
    rw [h₂] at h₁
    exact Set.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr h₁
  
  have h_subset_or_compl : ∀ (A : Set S), A ∈ P ∨ Aᶜ ∈ P := by
    intro A
    by_contra! h
    have h₁ : A ∉ P := h.1
    have h₂ : Aᶜ ∉ P := h.2
    
    have h₃ : ∃ (U : Set S), U ∈ P ∧ A ∩ U = ∅ := by
      have h₄ : ¬(A ∉ P ∧ ∀ (U : Set S), U ∈ P → A ∩ U ≠ ∅) := by
        intro h₅
        have h₆ : ∃ (T : Set S), T ∉ P ∧ (∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅) := by
          refine' ⟨A, _⟩
          constructor
          · exact h₅.1
          · intro U hU
            have h₇ := h₅.2 U hU
            have h₈ : A ∩ U ≠ ∅ := h₇
            have h₉ : A ∩ U = U ∩ A := by
              ext x
              simp only [mem_inter_iff]
              <;> tauto
            have h₁₀ : U ∩ A ≠ ∅ := by
              intro h₁₁
              apply h₈
              simp_all only [ne_eq, Set.ext_iff, mem_inter_iff, mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false, not_and, not_forall,
    not_not, not_exists, not_false_eq_true, and_self, not_true_eq_false]
              
            simpa [Set.inter_comm] using h₁₀
        exact hPS h₆
      by_cases h₅ : A ∉ P
      · have h₆ : ¬(∀ (U : Set S), U ∈ P → A ∩ U ≠ ∅) := by
          intro h₇
          exact h₄ ⟨h₅, h₇⟩
        push_neg at h₆
        obtain ⟨U, hU, h₈⟩ := h₆
        refine' ⟨U, hU, _⟩
        have h₉ : A ∩ U = ∅ := by
          by_contra h₁₀
          have h₁₁ : A ∩ U ≠ ∅ := h₁₀
          simp_all only [ne_eq, Set.ext_iff, mem_inter_iff, mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false, not_and, not_forall,
    not_not, not_exists, not_false_eq_true, and_self, true_and]
          
        exact h₉
      · exfalso
        simp_all only [ne_eq, not_exists, not_and, not_forall, not_not, not_false_eq_true, and_self]
    
    have h₄ : ∃ (V : Set S), V ∈ P ∧ Aᶜ ∩ V = ∅ := by
      have h₅ : ¬(Aᶜ ∉ P ∧ ∀ (U : Set S), U ∈ P → Aᶜ ∩ U ≠ ∅) := by
        intro h₆
        have h₇ : ∃ (T : Set S), T ∉ P ∧ (∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅) := by
          refine' ⟨Aᶜ, _⟩
          constructor
          · exact h₆.1
          · intro U hU
            have h₈ := h₆.2 U hU
            have h₉ : Aᶜ ∩ U ≠ ∅ := h₈
            have h₁₀ : Aᶜ ∩ U = U ∩ Aᶜ := by
              ext x
              simp only [mem_inter_iff, mem_compl_iff]
              <;> tauto
            have h₁₁ : U ∩ Aᶜ ≠ ∅ := by
              intro h₁₂
              apply h₉
              simp_all only [ne_eq, Set.ext_iff, mem_inter_iff, mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false, not_and, not_forall,
    not_not, not_exists, not_false_eq_true, and_self, mem_compl_iff, not_true_eq_false]
              
            simpa [Set.inter_comm] using h₁₁
        exact hPS h₇
      by_cases h₆ : Aᶜ ∉ P
      · have h₇ : ¬(∀ (U : Set S), U ∈ P → Aᶜ ∩ U ≠ ∅) := by
          intro h₈
          exact h₅ ⟨h₆, h₈⟩
        push_neg at h₇
        obtain ⟨V, hV, h₈⟩ := h₇
        refine' ⟨V, hV, _⟩
        have h₉ : Aᶜ ∩ V = ∅ := by
          by_contra h₁₀
          have h₁₁ : Aᶜ ∩ V ≠ ∅ := h₁₀
          simp_all only [ne_eq, Set.ext_iff, mem_inter_iff, mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false, not_and, not_forall,
    not_not, not_exists, not_false_eq_true, and_self, mem_compl_iff, true_and]
          
        exact h₉
      · exfalso
        simp_all only [ne_eq, not_exists, not_and, not_forall, not_not, not_false_eq_true, and_self]
    
    obtain ⟨U, hU, hU'⟩ := h₃
    obtain ⟨V, hV, hV'⟩ := h₄
    
    have h₅ : U ⊆ Aᶜ := by
      intro x hx
      by_contra h₆
      have h₇ : x ∈ A := by simp_all only [ne_eq, not_exists, not_and, not_forall, not_not, not_false_eq_true, and_self, mem_compl_iff]
      have h₈ : x ∈ A ∩ U := Set.mem_inter h₇ hx
      rw [hU'] at h₈
      simp only [mem_empty_iff_false] at h₈
      
    have h₆ : V ⊆ A := by
      intro x hx
      by_contra h₇
      have h₈ : x ∈ Aᶜ := by simp_all only [ne_eq, not_exists, not_and, not_forall, not_not, not_false_eq_true, and_self, mem_compl_iff]
      have h₉ : x ∈ Aᶜ ∩ V := Set.mem_inter h₈ hx
      rw [hV'] at h₉
      simp only [mem_empty_iff_false] at h₉
      
    
    have h₇ : U ∩ V = ∅ := by
      apply Set.eq_empty_of_forall_not_mem
      intro x hx
      have h₈ : x ∈ U := Set.mem_of_mem_inter_left hx
      have h₉ : x ∈ V := Set.mem_of_mem_inter_right hx
      have h₁₀ : x ∈ Aᶜ := h₅ h₈
      have h₁₁ : x ∈ A := h₆ h₉
      simp_all only [ne_eq, not_exists, not_and, not_forall, not_not, not_false_eq_true, and_self, mem_inter_iff,
    mem_compl_iff, not_true_eq_false]
      
    
    have h₈ : U ∩ V ≠ ∅ := hPP U hU V hV
    simp_all only [ne_eq, Set.ext_iff, mem_inter_iff, mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false, not_and, not_forall,
    not_not, not_exists, not_false_eq_true, and_self, mem_compl_iff]
    
  
  have h_not_both : ∀ (A : Set S), A ∈ P → Aᶜ ∉ P := by
    intro A hA
    by_contra h
    have h₁ : Aᶜ ∈ P := h
    have h₂ : A ∩ Aᶜ = ∅ := by
      ext x
      simp only [inter_compl_self, mem_empty_iff_false]
      
    have h₃ : A ∩ Aᶜ ≠ ∅ := hPP A hA Aᶜ h₁
    rw [h₂] at h₃
    contradiction
  
  have h_card : P.card = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1) := by
    classical
    
    let Q : Finset (Set S) := (Finset.univ : Finset (Set S)) \ P
    
    have h₁ : P.card = Q.card := by
      
      have h₂ : ∀ (A : Set S), A ∈ P → Aᶜ ∈ Q := by
        intro A hA
        have h₃ : Aᶜ ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Set S)) := Finset.mem_univ _
        have h₄ : Aᶜ ∉ P := h_not_both A hA
        simp only [Finset.mem_sdiff, Q] at *
        tauto
      have h₃ : ∀ (A : Set S), A ∈ Q → Aᶜ ∈ P := by
        intro A hA
        have h₄ : A ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Set S)) := by
          simp only [Finset.mem_sdiff, Q] at hA
          tauto
        have h₅ : A ∉ P := by
          simp only [Finset.mem_sdiff, Q] at hA
          tauto
        have h₆ : A ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Set S)) := by tauto
        have h₇ : A ∈ P ∨ Aᶜ ∈ P := h_subset_or_compl A
        cases h₇ with
        | inl h₈ =>
          exfalso
          tauto
        | inr h₈ =>
          exact h₈
      
      have h₄ : P.card = Q.card := by
        
        have h₅ : P.card = Q.card := by
          
          have h₆ : ∀ (A : Set S), A ∈ P → Aᶜ ∈ Q := h₂
          have h₇ : ∀ (A : Set S), A ∈ Q → Aᶜ ∈ P := h₃
          
          have h₈ : P.card = Q.card := by
            
            apply Finset.card_bij' (fun A _ => Aᶜ) (fun A _ => Aᶜ)
            <;> simp_all [Set.ext_iff]
            
            
            
            
          exact h₈
        exact h₅
      exact h₄
    
    have h₂ : P.card + Q.card = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := by
      have h₃ : P.card + Q.card = (Finset.univ : Finset (Set S)).card := by
        have h₄ : Disjoint P Q := by
          rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
          intro A hA hA'
          simp only [Finset.mem_sdiff, Q] at hA'
          tauto
        have h₅ : P ∪ Q = (Finset.univ : Finset (Set S)) := by
          apply Finset.ext
          intro A
          simp only [Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_sdiff, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Q]
          <;>
